verdict.rationale: Lago's API/OpenAPI schema and CSV export for analytics (lago-docs-15, lago-docs-16, lago-docs-1) mean a finance lead could theoretically pull subscription, invoice, and usage data out via API, and self-hosting (lago-docs-11) avoids lock-in of infrastructure. However, there is no documented bulk-export or migration tool, no explicit invoice/subscription/usage-record export workflow, and payment methods are held by external providers (Stripe etc.) rather than Lago itself, so 'porting stored payment methods' isn't addressed at all. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export/migration documentation, explicit payment-method portability mechanism, and any hands-on evidence of a successful migration off Lago.
